verdict.rationale: ClickUp's own MCP server docs list creating release notes from tasks and docs as a supported use case. However, the generation is done by a connected external AI assistant on request, and nothing shows a changelog being produced automatically for each release. missing for 10: automatic per-release changelog generation (trigger or recurring), a native changelog feature inside ClickUp, release/version tied output from GitHub/GitLab sync data, in-depth docs and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can auto-generate a changelog for each release so shipping progress is easy to review

citations.quote: Create release notes, status updates, and portfolio summaries from tasks and docs.
lets external AI agents interact with ClickUp Workspace data—like tasks, lists, folders, and docs—using natural language
